evidence_trust.reason: Certificate states 1.0 C at 06:40; the primary probe reads 4.2 C at the same minute.
Primary pulp probe, calibrated 2026-09-12, no gaps.

confidence_reasons: Probe and reefer air agree; certificate contradicts the probe.
Dock dwell contribution is small but not excluded.
payload.narrative: The lot was loaded warm: pulp stayed above 3 C for 5 h after harvest while the reefer held supply air at setpoint, so the carrier did not cause the excursion.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Continuing to Summit risks rejection at receipt: the arrival shelf-life margin is within the model's error band.
Re-routing to Harbor Foodservice preserves less value and the case is not urgent enough to give up the tier-A line.

payload.trade_off: Inspect at Central Valley DC costs a 4 h delay and the inspection fee, but resolves the conflicting certificate before committing a tier-A delivery.
payload.would_change_if: Inspection showed less than 10.5 days remaining, or the Harbor window closed before inspection.
payload.deviation_reason: The top risk-adjusted option (continue) relies on a certificate the probe contradicts.

invalid.why: the payload must match its submission type
